title: Reward Blindness: A Theoretical Framework for Diagnosing Reinforcement Learning Reward Limitations in Text-to-SQL
abstract: arXiv:2611.29930v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems let users without programming expertise query relational databases in natural language. Reinforcement learning has become the dominant way to train such systems, yet progress is still judged by a single number, execution accuracy, which counts correct queries but says nothing about which kinds of semantic error survive training. This paper develops a theoretical framework that examines text-to-SQL from the perspective of reward design. We introduce Reward Error Sensitivity, a measure of how strongly a reward function separates queries that contain a given error type from queries that do not, and prove a Reward Blindness theorem: when this sensitivity is zero, policy-gradient training carries no systematic signal for removing that error. Using fourteen published finegrained error signals for four text-to-SQL systems on the BIRD benchmark, we build error profiles and estimate sensitivities for common reward designs. Pre

translated_title: 奖励盲区：诊断文本到SQL中强化学习奖励局限性的理论框架
translated_abstract: 文本到SQL系统使没有编程专长的用户能够用自然语言查询关系数据库。强化学习已成为训练此类系统的主流方法，然而进展仍然仅由单一指标——执行准确率——来评判，该指标只统计正确的查询数量，却无法说明哪些类型的语义错误在训练后依然存在。本文开发了一个从奖励设计视角审视text-to-SQL的理论框架。我们提出了“奖励误差敏感度”这一度量指标，用于衡量奖励函数将包含特定错误类型的查询与不包含该错误类型的查询区分开来的能力，并证明了“奖励盲区”定理：当该敏感度为零时，策略梯度训练中不存在消除该错误的系统性信号。利用BIRD基准上已发表的十四种细粒度错误信号，针对四个text-to-SQL系统，我们构建了错误画像并估计了常见奖励设计的敏感度。
tldr: 本文提出“奖励误差敏感度”概念并证明“奖励盲区”定理，即当奖励函数无法区分含某类错误的查询时，策略梯度训练便缺乏消除该错误的系统性信号，从而为诊断text-to-SQL强化学习中奖励设计的局限性提供了理论框架与实证分析。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Reward Error Sensitivity and proves a Reward Blindness theorem—when a reward function cannot distinguish queries containing a given error type, policy-gradient training carries no systematic signal to remove that error—providing a theoretical framework and empirical analysis for diagnosing reward design limitations in reinforcement learning for text-to-SQL.
